'''2012 Worlds Day 2 Stefaan Lambrecht LS Rebel Strike Team''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Stefaan Lambrecht]] at [[2012 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Stefaan Lambrecht]]
* '''Event:''' [[2012 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Rebel Strike Team (V) / Garrison Destroyed (V)]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
